name: ScanBox local vision pack (Florence-2-base)
notes: Installed into engines\vision\florence2-base so it can coexist
alongside the larger Florence-2-large pack; switch between installed
sizes from the 'Photo/document model' choice at the top of Settings
Small (~355MB total), fast, ONNX-based photo description and OCR.
Handles both general photograph descriptions and document/receipt
transcription with one model. Runs through ONNX Runtime in-process
Fixed-prompt model, not an instructable chat-style one: it always
writes a short caption or reads text in a fixed way, rather than
following detailed style instructions the way a larger model can.
